My ViBe completion was previously stuck at 99.90%, which resulted in a 10% deduction from my HP. I had reported this to the support team via email and received a response stating that the deduction would be reverted soon. However, the correction has not yet been reflected.
In the meantime, any activities I complete are being calculated based on the reduced HP, which is causing my total HP to be lower than it should be.
I am from Euclideans Batch.
